sentences.text: Florida’s waters are your business, so protect them.
Obey manatee zone speed signs, and keep a lookout for manatees and sea turtles, especially in shallow water.
Running aground in seagrass and leaving propeller scars damages the habitat that supports your fishery and is illegal in many areas.
Know the rules of the Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary if you operate there.
Collect and recycle used fishing line, which kills birds, turtles and dolphins.
Report spills, injured wildlife and violations to the Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission at eight eight eight, four zero four, three nine two two.
